observations.coastal_road: Native-resolution review confirmed dark water with dikes for six northern additions. Most other candidates beside the road traced dikes or vegetation and were rejected. The two conspicuous unoutlined dark ponds adjacent to the simulated site fall inside the inherited authored-layout plus 35 m clearance; the cyan exclusion overlay confirmed this, so neither was admitted. A focused 0.15 pass added no accepted outlines.
observations.northern_fields: Inland dark/green field blocks contain crop rows or vegetation; they remain unadmitted. The additions at the northern coastal pond cluster show distinct banks and water, including aerator signatures. No classification of ambiguous flooded paddies is asserted.
observations.review_scope: Viewed old-red/new-yellow whole-area and three suspect-area overlays, every native detail tile, 15 individual crop contact sheets covering all prospective additions, and the authored-clearance overlay. Accepting an outline does not claim a surveyed fish-farm inventory; all remain static simulated context.
observations.south_of_lanyang: The belt clearly continues south of the river. Rectangular water compartments, farm sheds and aerator signatures were visible throughout the coastal matrix down to 24.680. Admit bounded pond footprints; reject river floodplain vegetation, rice plots, construction pits, dry dike strips and isolated foam/vegetation fragments inside other ponds.

visual_review.rejection_basis: Explicit indices rejected after image review for vegetation, crop/field texture, dry dikes, earthworks, or a fragmented surface without a separate clearly bounded pond.
visual_review.retained_coverage_limits: The admitted footprint stops at the requested 24.680 boundary; the imagery tile mosaic extends slightly beyond for inference overlap. No ponds outside the processing box are admitted.
